# mixggm

[![CRAN_Status_Badge](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/mixggm)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=mixggm)
[![CRAN_MonthlyDownloads](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/mixggm)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=mixggm)

An [R](https://www.r-project.org/) package implementing *Mixtures of
Gaussian Graphical Models* for model-based clustering with sparse
covariance and concentration matrices.

## Installation

You can install the released version of **mixggm** from CRAN:

    install.packages("mixggm")

## Usage

See
[`help(mixGGM)`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/mixGGM.md).

## References

Fop, M., Murphy, T.B., and Scrucca, L. (2019). “Model-based clustering
with sparse covariance matrices.” *Statistics and Computing*, *29*(4),
791–819. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s11222-018-9838-y>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`controlICF()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/control-parameters.md)
  [`controlSTEP()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/control-parameters.md)
  [`controlGA()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/control-parameters.md)
  [`controlEM()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/control-parameters.md)
  [`controlREG()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/control-parameters.md)
  : Set control parameters for various purposes
- [`fitGGM()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/fitGGM.md)
  : Fit a Gaussian graphical model
- [`mixGGM()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/mixGGM.md)
  : Mixture of Gaussian Graphical Models
- [`mixggm-package`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/mixggm-package.md)
  [`mixggm`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/mixggm-package.md)
  : Mixtures of Gaussian graphical models
- [`penalty`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/penalty.md)
  : Penalty functions for graph structure search
- [`plot(`*`<mixGGM>`*`)`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/plot.md)
  [`plot(`*`<fitGGM>`*`)`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/plot.md)
  : Plotting functionalities for Gaussian covariance and concentration
  graph models and their mixture
- [`predict(`*`<mixGGM>`*`)`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/predict.mixGGM.md)
  : Cluster prediction by Mixture of Gaussian Graphical Models
- [`searchGGM()`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/searchGGM.md)
  : Structure search and estimation for Gaussian graphical models
- [`summary(`*`<mixGGM>`*`)`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/summary.mixGGM.md)
  [`print(`*`<summary.mixGGM>`*`)`](https://mclust-org.github.io/mixggm/reference/summary.mixGGM.md)
  : Summarizing Mixture of Gaussian Graphical Models
